source: Poulopoulou, Modern Greek: Grammar Notes for Absolute Beginners (A1-A2), ΣΕΑΒ/Kallipos 2015, CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 GR (upload 8e8e722c), Chapter 5 (book pp. 66-81)
note: The book teaches genitive separately (Chapter 10, not in the uploaded pages), so only nominative and accusative appear here.
agreement_rule: Articles, numerals, quantifiers, adjectives and pronouns agree with the head noun in gender, number and case, not in ending shape (ακριβός χάρτης, ακριβός αναπτήρας).
word_order: article > demonstrative/numeral/quantifier > adjective(s) > noun; the adjective sits closest to the noun. Demonstratives need the definite article: αυτόν τον ακριβό χάρτη.

indefinite_article.note: Same as the numeral 'one'. No plural; κάποιος fills that role.

article_use.en: The dog is barking at the door.

article_use.el: Ένα παιδί πρέπει να ακούει τους γονείς του.
article_use.en: A child should listen to its parents.
A dog is barking at the door.

article_rules.rule: Definite article is obligatory in generic statements, with proper nouns, and with demonstratives and possessives.
article_rules.el: Μου αρέσει ο καφές. / ο Πέτρος / Αυτό το βιβλίο είναι ακριβό.
article_rules.en: I like coffee. / Peter / This book is expensive.

article_rules.rule: No article in habitual 'type' expressions and in predicates of είμαι.
article_rules.el: Πίνω καφέ το πρωί. / Ο Πέτρος είναι γιατρός.
article_rules.en: I have coffee in the morning. / Peter is a doctor.

numerals.note: Decimal, larger units first (εκατόν εβδομήντα δύο = 172). Only 1, 3 and 4 inflect; all others are invariable (δύο χάρτες / καρέκλες / βιβλία).

telling_time.question: Τι ώρα είναι;
telling_time.rules: Hours then minutes; και = past, παρά = to; τέταρτο = quarter, μισή = half. Hours are feminine (η ώρα), so μία, τρεις, τέσσερις.
telling_time.source_errata: Book gives 16.20 as 'Τέσσερις και δέκα'; corrected here to 'Τέσσερις και είκοσι'.

πολύς.adverb: πολύ = very / a lot; πάρα πολύ = very much

adjective_paradigms.rule: stem ends in a consonant → feminine -η
stem ends in a vowel → feminine -α

adjective_notes: Adjectives decline like nouns: masculine like δρόμος (-ος), feminine like ζώνη/ώρα, neuter like βιβλίο.
Dictionary form is masculine nominative singular.
Several adjectives: opinion before descriptive (ένα ωραίο ζεστό τσάι, ένα καινούριο γαλλικό εστιατόριο).
Ellipsis: drop the noun and keep article + adjective (Προτιμώ το μαύρο).

comparison.el: Ο Πέτρος είναι πιο ψηλός από τον Κώστα.
Ο Πέτρος είναι ο πιο ψηλός (από όλους).
Ο Πέτρος είναι το ίδιο ψηλός με τον Κώστα.
comparison.en: Peter is as tall as Kostas.
